title: Update Addresses Configuration
description: Configuration schema for nft-update-addresses - defines nftables set configurations based on MAC addresses

interfaces.description: Map of interface configurations keyed by interface name

nftTable.description: nftables table name (alphanumeric with underscores, hyphens)

macAddress.description: MAC address: 12 hex characters (0-9a-f) with optional separators (':', '.', '_', '-') between them. Examples: aabbccddeeff, aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff, aa-bb-cc-dd-ee-ff, aa.bb.cc.dd.ee.ff, aa_bb_cc_dd_ee_ff

setDataType.description: nftables set element data type (can be a single type, a concatenation like 'ipv6_addr . inet_proto . inet_service', or a mapping like 'inet_proto . inet_service : ipv6_addr . inet_service')

setFlags.description: Comma-separated list of set flags: interval, timeout, concat

macs.description: List of MAC addresses to monitor for this interface

setConfig.description: Configuration for an nftables set with template-based elements

name.description: Name of the set (optional, can be used to override the key name)

set_type.description: Type of nftables set (determines set behavior)

elements.description: List of element templates. Templates can contain variable placeholders like ${ipv6_eth0_aabbccddeeff} for dynamic substitution
